input_hash_check.note: sha256 recomputed from the working tree at review time; a mismatch would mean the proposal was not scored against the canonical pages now on disk.

method: Independent text/policy adjudication. Every proposal row was checked against the verbatim canonical transcript of the page it names (id, line number, line text, written substring, host line kind and scored flag, host [cut]/clipped marker) and every verdict is a reading of that text plus its local context. No image was inspected and no canonical file was written.
decision_rules: ACCEPT: the canonical line text is verbatim, the disputed word is inside the line's recorded visible text, and the local context (syntax, the notebook's own parallel lines, or the rule the page studies) fixes both a specific pupil error and one specific expected form, without the source the pupil copied.

UNDECIDED: the written form is recorded verbatim and is deviant, but the required correction needs a source not held in the frozen inputs (song lyric, textbook rule) or the transcript itself records the reading as uncertain; error_rule then forbids counting it.

REJECT: the item is not a pupil error: a normal wrap, a masked/edge-clipped word, a heading/table/drill or abbreviation, teacher ink, an ink-spacing or note-taking convention, a duplicate of another record, or a claim with no specific defect (LABELLING-POLICY §1-§3, §6; policy.json excluded[]).

residual_limits: No pixel inspection was performed by this reviewer; every ACCEPT rests on the canonical transcript's recorded text. An ACCEPT therefore means 'specific pupil error and correction established from the frozen text' and remains verified_from_pixels=false until Astra's pixel pass.

Every ACCEPT was machine-checked to be on a scored pupil-writing line (handwritten, or highlighted for P42-E02) and to carry a disputed word that is inside the line's recorded visible text. Ten of them sit on lines the transcript marks [cut]/clipped (P37-E01, P38-E04, P38-E11, P39-E01, P40-E01, P40-E02, P40-E03, P41-E01, P41-E03, P41-E04) but with the disputed word mid-line rather than at the cut edge; the one exception is P41-E01, whose host p41-l05 is cut at the start and whose whole recorded text is the disputed word 'ежёвый', so that word's completeness rests on the transcript alone (page 41's edge_clipped lists no fragment for that line).

Absence claims (missing commas, dashes, words) depend on the transcript's fidelity for marks. The transcripts demonstrably record commas, colons, hyphens, dashes and periods elsewhere, including on the parallel lines each ACCEPT cites, but a transcription omission cannot be excluded without pixels.

Mask bookkeeping did not reconcile from text alone and is left as a question for Astra, not used by any verdict: pages 37, 38 and 41 carry edge_clipped boxes (9, 22, 17) with mask_status 'UNMASKED - Astra re-measuring by eye'; pages 39, 40, 42, 43, 44, 45 and 46 have edge_clipped empty and mask_decision_2026-09-12 'this page is not masked; all previous masks removed', yet pages 39, 40 and 43 still carry [cut]/clipped line markers (14, 20 and 4 lines) and the visible fragments recorded in page 41's edge_clipped ('шорты,', 'грушевый,') occur in no transcript line anywhere in the corpus. Deferred flags follow LABELLING-POLICY §1 (letters: deferred false; agreement, case, word boundary, missing word, punctuation and capitalization: deferred true), so an accepted item in a deferred category never enters a catch or false-flag figure.

Expected forms and error classes were carried through unchanged from the proposal; this review invented no correction, and source-dependent corrections (P42-E01, P44-E01, P37-U02, P38-U02, P42-U01, P43-U02) are deferred rather than accepted.
